title: A Windows clone works end to end
goal: On Windows 11 with Git for Windows, a clone goes from no Python to a passing /kb-setup: _tools/install-python.ps1 installs the pinned Python and uv after a host conflict preflight, the skills and permission rules work from the PowerShell tool as well as the Bash tool, a missing interpreter is announced at session start, and tests.py and stress_test.py pass on Windows.
notes: Out of scope, host setup rather than repository changes: running kbgit.py install-hooks and kb_mcp.py --register-local in a clone (/kb-setup does), a remote layout, turning off the Store's App Execution Aliases, enabling LongPathsEnabled, running Claude Code unelevated. The test-suite failures are BG-ovulgaal in sprint SP-z7a5c76b.
